g.title: worker-tick
g.text: Worker tick: one agent, one hour, and every point where it stops without acting
Any failure ends the tick with no action, and that outcome is final for that tick key.
Exercised on Monad testnet
Implemented, off or not yet run on testnet
Designed, not built or not deployed
Source: ARCHITECTURE.md sections 10, 11, 14; SECURITY.md section 8

g.title: t1
g.text: Trigger job fires
Tick number = whole tick intervals since the Unix epoch
Same number in every process for the same interval

g.title: t2
g.text: Enqueue tick job
Job id derived from the tick key (agent id, tick number)
A duplicate trigger adds nothing

g.title: t3
g.text: Take the per-agent Redis lock
Concurrency of 1 per agent; lock held: retry later,
not counted as a failed attempt

g.title: ev
g.text: Evaluate job, every 20th tick
Enqueued with the trigger, delayed by half a tick interval
so that tick's agent jobs run first (diagram 5)

g.title: t2->ev
g.text: on the evaluation cadence

g.title: t4
g.text: Sample the market mid
(best bid + best ask) / 2, first valid read of the tick,
stored once in market_mid_samples, funded agent or not

g.title: t5
g.text: Policy gate
Verify every stored policy version against WORKER_POLICY_SIGNER;
one in effect must cover the configured market
Otherwise skipped before anything is claimed or sent

g.title: t6
g.text: Claim the tick record
Insert-if-absent per (agent id, tick); a restart resumes
the approved plan and never decides again

g.title: stop
g.text: No action, final for this tick key
Unreadable chain or market, policy missing or unverified,
plan not buildable, RiskModule rejection, signer refusal,
unknown outcome: stays open and is reconciled by the same key
The next scheduled tick runs normally

g.title: t5->stop
g.text: no valid policy

g.title: t7
g.text: Observe and read the signal
Balance and rolling-window spend read from chain
Signal = trailing mean of mid returns over timeHorizon, minus entryThreshold

g.title: t8
g.text: Propose and build the plan
Long: approve exact notional, then swap with minAmountOut
Flat: close the whole open position; no information offered

g.title: t7->stop
g.text: read or signal fails

g.title: t9
g.text: RiskModule evaluates the plan
Approval and plan hash written to the tick record before submission

g.title: t10
g.text: Submit through the session key
Only a plan whose hash equals the approved hash is sent
Restart: reconcile by tick key before any resend

g.title: t9->stop
g.text: rejected

g.title: t11
g.text: Measure once per tick key
Gas, fees, slippage, x402 spend, realized P&L of a close
become one fitness cost entry

g.title: t10->stop
g.text: signer refuses

g.title: gap
g.text: Known limits, not verified live
No tick has run on the live deployment
Signal needs timeHorizon + 1 whole samples:
25 ticks with the conservative preset
A flat seeded book gives signal 0, so no buy
